# Source: Botanical Specimen

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Botanical Specimen
- **Artist / culture:** William Henry Fox Talbot English, 1800–1877
- **Date:** c. 1835
- **Style:** 19th century
- **Classification:** salted paper print
- **Department:** Photography and Media
- **AIC artwork ID:** 38927
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/38927
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/13e8b1a0-4184-6add-ec70-efd1a9667619/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Botanical

## Extracted source palette

`#887868, #686858, #B8B898, #989878, #98A898`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#36362E`
- `surface`: `#4D4D46`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#887868`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#B8B898`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D4D46`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C6C66`
- `error`: `#887868`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.46:1`, surface `8.01:1`
- Variant contrast: `8.01:1`
- Control contrast: `4.59:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
